description: Lisa Freeman reaches out to David Chen to accept his offered conversation about lending products for retraining program participants. She brings anonymized composite profiles of attendees with non-traditional income histories who have demonstrated repayment capacity but fail standard qualification screens. She is not relitigating the categorical carve-out request. She is taking him up on his explicit offer of a 'principled alternative pathway.'

resources.detail: Lisa provides structured profile data to inform product matching; David Chen provides information on existing bank products and eligibility criteria.

expected_outcome: Identification of at least one bank lending product that could serve retraining participants with variable or interrupted income histories — to be documented and brought to Maria Santos's task force as a concrete community resource.
